Usage:
  mcp-gateway --stdio -- <command> [args...]     Proxy a local MCP server (stdio)

Transport:
  --stdio              Use stdio transport (spawn local server)
  --http               Use Streamable HTTP transport
  --target <url>       Target MCP server URL (HTTP mode)
  --port <n>           Gateway listen port (HTTP mode, default: 3100)
  --host <addr>        Gateway listen host (default: 127.0.0.1)

Security:
  --no-verify          Disable CCS verification (pass-through mode)
  --no-fail-closed     Warn-only mode (blocked calls still forwarded)
  --no-output-scan     Disable output/response scanning
  --no-protocol-verify Disable protocol-metadata verification (tools/list baseline,
                       schema consistency, response stamps, field-order hashing)
  --require-response-stamp Require a valid signed response stamp on tool responses
  --server-public-key <file>  PEM file containing the MCP server's public key
                       (required when --require-response-stamp is used)
  --response-key-id <id> Expected response stamp keyId (optional)
  --field-order <mode> Output field-order change action: warn|block (default: warn)
  --sign-receipts      Enable Ed25519 receipt signing (auto-generates key)
  --policy <file>      Policy configuration file (JSON)
  --api-key <key>      Add an API key for client authentication (repeatable)
  --caller-id <id>     Caller ID mapped from --api-key (repeatable, in same order)
  --admin-key <key>    Admin API key for /admin endpoints
  --max-body <bytes>   Maximum request body size (default: 1048576)

Operations:
  --receipt-dir <dir>  Directory to write CCS receipts (JSONL)
  --retention <days>   Receipt retention days (default: 90)
  --enable-metrics     Enable Prometheus /metrics endpoint
  --log-level <level>  debug|info|warn|error (default: info)
  --log-format <fmt>   text|json (default: text)
  --timeout <ms>       Upstream timeout in ms (default: 120000)
  --circuit-threshold <n>  Consecutive failures before circuit opens (default: 5)
  --circuit-reset <ms>     Circuit breaker reset timeout (default: 30000)
  --rate-limit <rpm>   Global rate limit (requests per minute)
  --max-concurrency <n>    Max concurrent requests (default: unlimited)

Misc:
